faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NISER?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NISER is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Physics or a B.E/B.Tech. in Electronics. Additionally, a valid CSIR-UGC NET or GATE qualification is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per the rules and regulations of NISER.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the NISER Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely via email. Candidates need to send their complete application with all required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in interview date for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The online interview for the Junior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 05th October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Science Education and Research Bhubaneswar (NISER).

faq.question: Q10. Where is NISER Bhubaneswar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER) is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with the pincode 752050.
